LESSON: PUNCTUAT IONS AND INDICATOR

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: FRENCH BRAILLE
Topic 8.3: PUNCTUAT IONS AND INDICATOR
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers PUNCTUAT IONS AND INDICATOR, part of FRENCH BRAILLE in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: How do you indicate a letter sign in French braille?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify punctuation signs and indicator in French braille by naming the dots that form them for knowledge

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of PUNCTUAT IONS AND INDICATOR in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. read out punctuation signs and indicator in French braille for pose and intonation;

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of PUNCTUAT IONS AND INDICATOR in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. write punctuations signs and indicator in French braille for skill development;

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of PUNCTUAT IONS AND INDICATOR in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.
